tags.name: Authentication
tags.description:
**PUBLIC** - User authentication endpoints. No authentication required.

Includes login, registration, password reset, and token refresh.

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description:
**PUBLIC** - OAuth 2.0 provider integration. No authentication required.

Supports Apple and Corporate OAuth providers.

tags.name: System
tags.description:
**PUBLIC** - System health and status endpoints. No authentication required.

Includes health checks, status, and version info.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description:
**PROTECTED** - User profile management. Requires JWT Bearer token.

Manage authenticated user's profile information.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description:
**PROTECTED** - User notification management. Requires JWT Bearer token.

List, read, and manage user notifications.

tags.name: Session
tags.description:
**PROTECTED** - Session health and metrics. Requires JWT Bearer token.

Monitor session status and health.

tags.name: User Management
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - User CRUD operations. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Create, read, update, delete, and manage user accounts.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Role management. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Manage user roles and permissions.

tags.name: POIs
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Points of Interest management. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Manage location points for services.

tags.name: Rates
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Rate zone management. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Manage pricing rates by zone.

tags.name: Service Types
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Service type catalog. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Manage available service types.

tags.name: Vehicle Types
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Vehicle type catalog. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Manage available vehicle types.

tags.name: Vehicles
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Vehicle management. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Manage vehicle fleet.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Billing information. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Manage billing and invoicing data.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Audit log management. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Access audit trails for compliance (PCI DSS).

tags.name: Payment Info
tags.description:
**ADMIN** - Payment information. Requires JWT + Admin/SuperAdmin role.

Manage payment methods and details.
